integrity: Complete elementary analytic proof accompanies independent finite arithmetic checks; computational tests alone do not certify the universal theorem. Originality review is non-exhaustive and independent validation has not occurred.
limitations: Does not cover different means, non-proportional covariance matrices, three or more scale atoms, or continuous scale mixtures. A plausible closely related 2016 paper was only partially accessible and the 2026 general separation preprint was available only at abstract level; equivalent previous results remain possible.
scope: Two centered isotropic Gaussian components with unequal positive scales and interior mixing weight, arbitrary integer dimension; exact pointwise log-concavity threshold and linear-projection boundary.
title: A sharp dimension-dependent log-concavity threshold for two-scale Gaussian mixtures
